name: kaggle_gpu
does: Run a Python script on Kaggle's free GPU (about 30 hours a week, 16 GB T4 or P100 - twice this PC's 8 GB) and bring back the files it writes: big models, long renders, training, anything too heavy for the machine

script.description: the .py file in the job's folder to run there (it writes its results to its working folder)

title.description: a short name for the run

inputs.description: files the script needs (uploaded beside it; their folder is $LOKI_INPUTS)

minutes.description: how long to wait for it

attach.description: a run already started (user/name, from <out>/kernel.txt): wait for it and fetch its files instead of starting it again
